entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Order number is VF789-01B. Can you process this or not?
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the band or just a matter of preference?
It's a preference. It's not for me. I don't have time to go through a long process, I just need to know if it's returnable.
Understood. No problem at all. Let me pull up your account... Okay, I see the delivery was 20 days ago. You're all set. Our return policy for this item is 90 days.

That's right. After that period, it would be too late due to our hygiene and sanitation guidelines for wearable electronics. But since you're well within that window, I've just approved the return for a full refund.

I've just emailed you a pre-paid shipping label. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center. And because I see you're one of our VIP customers, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase.
Oh. Okay, a credit is fine. I've got the email. Thanks for being quick about it.
Of course. We appreciate your business. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
